definition.simple: When iron gets wet and mixes with air, it slowly turns into a crumbly reddish-brown stuff called rust.
definition.academic: The chemical process in which iron reacts with oxygen and moisture (water) in the air to form iron oxide, commonly known as rust.

examples: An old bicycle left in the rain turning reddish-brown
Iron nails left outside getting crusty and weak

common_misconceptions: Rust is just dirt that collects on iron (False, it is actually the iron itself turning into a new substance).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student: 'What two things does iron need to touch in order to rust?' (Oxygen and water)
